messages:
deploy-bot: scheduled schema-apply: user_profiles v2026.03.21 -> starting 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z (5256789012). Regions: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1. We will run in staggered tenant-range waves (ranges: 0-1999,2000-3999,4000+). Runbook: https://runbook.internal/migrations/user_profiles

maria: saw lock spikes on the canary last night (p99 lock wait ~7s). recommend: 1) run a single-tenant-range canary first (0-1999), 2) quiesce window 300s, 3) per-shard sequencing to avoid global table locks.

sam: +1 to canary. also: pin web-app to release 1.42.3 during the migration to avoid accidental code paths hitting new column early. pinned build: 1.42.3 (sha: b7f4a1d).

kevin: add an automated holdpoint after wave1 that requires an "ACK" before wave2 proceeds. If avg lock > 5s or error rate +3% rollback. I can add a short alert rule to the deploybot that watches pg_locks and slow queries.

anna: rollback playbook: if we hit >10s locks for more than 2 consecutive minutes or replication lag spikes > 30s, run:
```
deploybot rollback migration user_profiles v2026.03.21
# then: run quick fix: revert feature-flag user_profiles_new_col false, notify support, open incident channel
```
Make sure release notes mention the column as opt-in via FF.

maria: SQL snippet to detect long locks during canary (run on monitoring replica):
```sql
SELECT pid, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS duration, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state = 'active' AND now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start > interval '3 seconds';
```
Use that to gate wave2.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. updated plan: canary -> tenant-range 0-1999 only at 02:00 UTC. quiesce window set to 300s. automated holdpoint will pause after canary until an "ACK" from one of: maria, sam, kevin. holdpoint condition: pg_lock_wait_p50 > 2s OR p99 > 6s OR error_rate +2%. If condition tripped, wave2 will not auto-start. logs: https://logs.redwood/migrations/user_profiles/5256789012

sam: adding a short release-note blurb: "Opt-in column added to user_profiles; rollout behind feature flag. No downtime expected. Admins: pin to 1.42.3 during window." I'll drop into release-notes draft repo.

kevin: I'll add a temporary slow_query monitor and a dashboard link to the runbook. Also pushing a perftrace tag for the canary run.

anna: ops-oncall pinged and standing by. if we do abort, I'll own the rollback and postmortem triage.

maria: canary approved assuming the holdpoint and quiesce are active. ACK from maria. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: holdpoint set and awaiting manual ACKs for wave2. scheduled start confirmed. will post wave start/complete messages in this thread. :rocket:
